name: Giant Propel Advanced SL 1 (Gen 4)
why_interesting: A current official mainland page now resolves the exact fourth-generation Propel Advanced SL 1 trim, CNY 54,800 suggested price and Ultegra Di2 BOM. Official Giant testing supplies protocol-backed frame and fork stiffness values.
missing: Mainland-delivered complete-bike weight and weighing basis; 6.8 kg size S is an exact official Japan trim reference
Exact size/color stock, final checkout and transaction-specific warranty still require dealer/store confirmation

facts.frame: Advanced SL-grade composite frame and Advanced SL full-composite fork
facts.sizes: XS-XL; the global 2026 page supplies a full frame geometry table; mainland-specific geometry is not yet text-verified
facts.geometry_basis: Giant global 2026 exact-model page; current China geometry is shown as images and was not independently compared. Use this as a global frame reference, not a verified China-market fit chart.
facts.complete_weight_reference: 6.8 kg in size S on the official Japan page for the same named 2027 trim; the mainland page does not publish complete-bike weight
facts.complete_weight_basis: Giant Japan's official MY2027 Propel Advanced SL 1 page lists 6.8 kg in size S. The listed build specifies an Advanced SL composite frame and fork, Contact SLR 0 Aero cockpit, Ultegra Di2, SLR 0 50 wheels and CADEX Aero 700x28 tires; pedals are N/A. The page lists a computer mount, two bottle cages, tubeless valves and sealant but does not say whether those extras are included in the weight. Giant says individual weight may vary slightly. This Japan-market size-S reference is not verified as the mainland stock build, whose page does not publish complete-bike weight.
facts.drivetrain: Shimano Ultegra Di2 electronic hydraulic 2x12 with 11-34T cassette and 52/36T Giant Power Pro power-meter crank
facts.frame_stiffness_evidence: Giant manufacturer protocol fixes the dropouts and dummy fork, inclines the frame 10 degrees and applies force at the pedal eye; values are manufacturer testing rather than independent lab results
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer testing for fourth-generation 2027 Propel: frame pedaling stiffness 84 N/mm, frame torsional stiffness 124 N/degree and fork stiffness 60 N/mm. Giant manufacturer protocol fixes the dropouts and dummy fork, inclines the frame 10 degrees and applies force at the pedal eye; values are manufacturer testing rather than independent lab results
facts.bill_of_materials: The exact mainland Advanced SL 1 page lists Shimano Ultegra Di2 2×12, an 11–34 cassette, 52/36 Giant Power Pro crank, Giant SLR 0 50 wheels, and CADEX Aero 700×28 tires. Other components are not inferred from this list.

support_note: Giant's current mainland page offers an official dealer locator and online-buy route, but no exact size/color stock or checkout was verified. The current China warranty policy provides conditional frame/fork/component coverage only for eligible mainland purchases assembled by authorized dealers; transaction-specific eligibility still needs dealer confirmation.
source_note: Current official mainland evidence resolves the exact trim, CNY 54,800 suggested price and Ultegra Di2 BOM. Giant global provides geometry and 32 mm clearance with a regional caveat; the China geometry remains image-only. Giant testing currently reports manufacturer stiffness values for the fourth-generation frame. Warranty policy is documented; the official gallery has no verified reuse license, so no image is added.

official_price.price_basis: Exact Giant China Propel Advanced SL 1 suggested retail price; current stock, selected size/color and final checkout remain unverified
